name: glm53-context-sweep
description: GLM-5.3-Flash REAP50 long-context points 4k-1M on 2x L40 (one server per point).
caveats: One server per context point because llama.cpp's -c is shared across -np slots.
The 1M point is attempted last with a hard timeout and is expected to be compute-bound on the dense DSA fallback; earlier points are kept if it times out.
This is the llama.cpp/GGUF path, not the SGLang NVFP4 maximum-throughput path.
context-sweep.sh starts its own server; run it inside an allocation, never on the login node.
The 2026-10-22 JSON is the 2x48GB run; do not mix it with the 2xA100 paged-KV numbers.
